msgs:
KITCHEN IS OPEN.
CHEF IS HAPPY {g}

TODAY'S MENU:
WHATEVER IS
IN THE FRIDGE

Best ideas are
born in
the kitchen

Last one to finish
does the dishes

Smell of baking
is the smell
of home

Food is love
you can eat

Recipe for happiness:
good dinner,
good people

Lunch is ready!
To the table!

Coffee without sugar,
life with
something sweet

The best chef
cleans up
after himself

Loaded the
dishwasher?
You're a hero

Fruit on the table.
Help yourself {o}{r}{y}

Breakfast is ready!
Everyone to
the kitchen

Coffee smell beats
any alarm clock

Soup on the stove,
bread on the table

Who ate the last
piece of cake?

Salt, pepper and
a pinch of
inspiration

A cup of tea
fixes a lot

Hungry means
grumpy.
Fed means happy

Hummus, pita
and a good mood

Open the fridge
slowly: surprise
inside

A little chef
is growing up
in this kitchen

Cookies in the
oven. Hands off!

The chef is
on fire today.
Not literally

Hot tea on
a cold day

Cold lemonade on
a hot day {y}

Your turn to
do the dishes {r}

Made coffee?
Make one
for me too

What's for dinner?
The eternal
question

Recipe of the day:
omelet with love

Silence in the
kitchen means
everyone is eating

Pizza is a
circle of
friendship

No dessert today?
Never heard
of it

Out of bread.
Who's going
to the shop?

Frying onions?
Something good
is coming

Mom's soup is
the best soup

A mug of tea
and a warm blanket

A clean sink
at night,
a happy morning
